Aerodynamics Engineer

Getafe, Comunidad de Madrid, España · Full time · Permanent · Professional
HybridFlight & Space Physics
Apply

About the job

An opportunity for a senior Aerodynamics Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence & Space in Getafe (Spain).

The successful applicant will join the team responsible for the aerodynamic development and optimisation of Airbus Defence & Space aircraft, having the opportunity to participate in diverse activities as external shape aerodynamic design, generation of complex and comprehensive aerodynamic models and data on performance, handling qualities and loads in steady and unsteady mode, safe separation analysis and experimental wind tunnel test campaigns; all carried out in the multidisciplinary environment of Flight Physics and in collaboration with specialists of international partners.

Responsibilities

  • Design air vehicle external shapes and provide comprehensive aerodynamic models and data on performance, handling qualities and loads in steady and unsteady mode.
  • Ensure that optimised aerodynamic solutions and data are delivered to customers on time, cost and quality.
  • Develop and maintain technologies, methods, tools, skills and competencies for the Aerodynamics disciplines.
  • Contribute to aircraft aerodynamic and flight performance requirements throughout the product life cycle.
  • Develop expertise in numerical and experimental aerodynamic prediction tools.
  • Acquire and develop aerodynamic technologies consistent with Company Strategy.
  • Link with the external research community and with structures, loads, stability & control and mass-properties disciplines.

Skills

  • Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering; a PhD is valuable.
  • At least 5 years of experience in aerodynamic design and characterisation.
  • Strong experience in meshing, numerical aerodynamic prediction tools, aerodynamic databases from experimental and CFD data, and CAD tools.
  • Valuable: wind-tunnel testing, safe separation, Python and Matlab.
  • Advanced English; German and/or French is valuable.

Benefits

  • Vacation days and additional days off.
  • Attractive salary and collective transport subject to calendar and home location.
  • Life and health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan and study grants.
  • On-site canteen, kindergarten and medical office.
  • Upskilling, development prospects and flexible working arrangements.

This job requires awareness of compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity.
